doc.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018

title: Jazz's future in America and abroad
summary: She says young people in the US see jazz as for old people, while audiences abroad are mixed and dance.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Well hip hop carries more weight than bebop.

Yeah it seems, these days. You know and then also people see, I don’t know, it’s just very interesting. I think people don’t see a future or bright lights and whatever in jazz. They think oh jazz is for old people or something. But then, that’s only in America. When we travel I have young audiences, mixed everything, people are dancing, they’re having a good time, they’re — so in the states it’s tough. It’s really tough.
